florida-nrcs-state-office.label: Headquarters & Administrative
florida-nrcs-state-office.description: Large administrative/regional headquarters with high telework capability and continuity-of-operations duties.
florida-nrcs-state-office.rationale: With most staff able to work remotely, a hazard to commutes usually calls for telework rather than closure; closure is reserved for threats to the building itself.

florida-nrcs-state-office.label: Research Labs & Stations
florida-nrcs-state-office.description: Labs and research stations with animals, plants, cold storage or experiments that cannot be left unattended.
florida-nrcs-state-office.rationale: Essential care staff (animals, greenhouse, freezers) must keep coverage even when the rest of the site is closed, so thresholds are higher and essential staff are planned for separately.
florida-nrcs-state-office.action: Normal operations; verify backup power and critical-care contact roster.

florida-nrcs-state-office.label: Field Offices
florida-nrcs-state-office.description: Field-operations offices (inspection, wildlife, forestry-style) whose staff work outdoors or on the road.
florida-nrcs-state-office.rationale: Outdoor/vehicle work is stopped before office work is, and low telework eligibility means exposed staff are more likely to need leave than telework.
florida-nrcs-state-office.action: Normal operations; review field assignments against active watches.

florida-nrcs-state-office.label: Service Centers
florida-nrcs-state-office.description: Public-facing county offices (e.g. FSA/NRCS/RD style) serving walk-in customers.
florida-nrcs-state-office.rationale: Customers arrive unannounced and cannot be pre-warned, so the office acts earlier on facility-area hazards and has no round-the-clock essential minimum.
florida-nrcs-state-office.action: Open; keep lobby staff aware of active watches.
